user.title: Zoraxy
user.description: Connect a Zoraxy reverse proxy. Use the internal address of the web interface, not a proxied domain.

data_description.url: Address of the Zoraxy web interface, for example {example_url}. Without a scheme, http and port 8000 are assumed.
data_description.username: Zoraxy admin user. Zoraxy has no restricted roles, so the integration has full access.
data_description.password: Stored in the config entry and hidden in diagnostics.
data_description.verify_ssl: Only relevant for https. Turn off for self-signed certificates.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Zoraxy at {url} rejected the stored credentials.

error.cannot_connect: Zoraxy not reachable, or the address is not a Zoraxy web interface.

abort.already_configured: This Zoraxy instance is already configured.
abort.different_instance: The address belongs to a different Zoraxy instance.

init.title: Zoraxy options
init.description: Control functions are off by default.

data_description.scan_interval: How often hosts, statistics and certificates are read.
data_description.uptime_interval: How often the uptime monitor is read. Zoraxy checks upstreams every 5 minutes and returns a whole day of history, so polling more often only costs traffic.
data_description.control_hosts: One switch per proxy host to enable or disable it.
data_description.control_proxy: A switch that stops or starts the whole reverse proxy – all hosts at once.
data_description.control_access: Switches for blacklist and whitelist per access rule, plus the actions block IP and unblock IP.
data_description.control_streams: One switch per TCP/UDP stream proxy.
data_description.control_certificates: A button that starts the ACME renewal right away.

control_disabled.message: This action is turned off in the options of {title}.

entry_not_found.message: Zoraxy entry not found or not loaded.

entry_ambiguous.message: Several Zoraxy instances are configured, choose one.

block_ip.name: Block IP
block_ip.description: Adds an address to the blacklist of an access rule. The blacklist of the rule must be enabled to take effect.

config_entry_id.name: Zoraxy instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several instances are configured.

ip.name: IP address
ip.description: Single address or range in CIDR notation.

rule.name: Access rule
rule.description: Name or ID of the access rule, default is the rule used by all hosts.

unblock_ip.name: Unblock IP
unblock_ip.description: Removes an address from the blacklist of an access rule.
